title: Identifier
description: A scoped external identifier — a GTIN/barcode (scheme=gtin), a lot number (scheme=lot), or an internal system code. Used for Label.identity_compliance.lot. Package.gtin uses scheme=gtin only and does not carry lot/batch (see three lot/batch shapes: LabResult.batch_lot string, Label lot Identifier, Package.gtin GTIN-only). Lot vs Batch left open.
